rationale: Equal full-panel coverage of blinded manuscripts, one deep neutral assessment, shorter external-provider check; begin with three manuscripts.
comparability: Exploratory philosophical selection. Same rubric and frozen profile per judge, no validated judge replicas or controlled historical method comparison.
independent_critique: Fresh context per judge-manuscript pair and per neutral/Claude review; separation observable, intellectual independence not certified.
budget: Pilot: 3 Astra/high deep + 69 Luna/high panel + 3 Claude Opus5.5/medium short; full design 100+2300 main assessments after pilot inspection. Subscription only; no quota automation.
blindness: Only manuscript, bibliography, shared rubric and assigned source-grounded judge packet. No author/model/process biography, prior rating or cross-essay memory.
